expectations.text: Uses resource() with params that tracks the symbol signal reactively
expectations.evidence: stock.service.ts:30-31 uses `resource({ params: () => ({ symbol: this._symbol() }), ...})` — correct params-based reactive tracking

expectations.text: Passes abortSignal to fetch/http call for request cancellation
expectations.evidence: stock.service.ts:33-36 destructures `abortSignal` from loader params and passes it to `fetch(..., { signal: abortSignal })`

expectations.text: Uses resource status signals (isLoading, hasValue, error) in the template
expectations.evidence: stock-dashboard.component.ts template uses `isLoading()`, `stockResource.hasValue()`, and `error()` computed signal for conditional rendering
stock.service.ts:55 exposes `refresh()` method calling `this.stockResource.reload()`, used in component's refreshData()

expectations.text: Preserves previous value during loading (via resourceFromSnapshots, linkedSignal, or reloading status check)
expectations.evidence: stock-dashboard.component.ts template shows old data with `.stale` CSS class while isLoading(), and separately handles initial load vs reload states. Uses hasValue() + isLoading() combination.

expectations.text: Does NOT use effect() to sync resource state to another signal
expectations.evidence: No effect() calls in either service or component. State is derived via computed() and direct resource signal access.
